result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make the reality of other minds impossible to ignore.

Not force everyone to agree, or be kind, or even like each other. Just make it so you could never genuinely experience another person as less real, less feeling, less human than yourself. You could still disagree, fight, protect yourself—but you couldn’t quietly erase them inside your head.

Most cruelty starts there: with that small, convenient blindness. I’d remove the blindness.

Most cruelty starts there: with that small, convenient blindness. I’d remove the blindness.
